about_the_game:
Dash, shoot and strike in this lightning-paced hack n' slash roguelike set in a gothic, undying world!

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making and stylish strings of attacks, BloodRush encourages a creative approach to combat, combining abilities to demolish your foes!

  • String together new combos by combining weapon attacks with movement abilities;

  • Always a chance for comeback - rush to recover Blood by executing enemies;

  • Waiting is dying - as your health constantly drains out, you must move quickly to escape death!

  • A variety of enemies and bosses stand in the way of Death's liberation, forming the Cult of Eternity;

  • Dance in eight combat arenas, each with different mechanics and challenges to interact with;

  • Sharpen a different build every run with diverse weapon combinations, abilities and talents.

  • Delve into Death's domain in multiple runs, unlocking the Stranger's vast arsenal of 6 weapons, 10+ combos, 20+ talents, and more;

  • Uncover insights into Death's imprisonment, progressively learning more of her captors' motivations and philosophies at every run;

  • Fight in a beautiful pixel-art world, accompanied by a gothic-inspired soundtrack and atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes:
This is a combat-heavy game, so naturally there's violence. Blood can be disabled through settings.

The game's narrative also deals with themes of personal loss, death, animal death, physical and mental pain, and depersonalization.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-1115G4
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics card requires Vulkan compatibility to support some shaders.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Graphics card requires Vulkan compatibility to support some shaders.
